clips.title: The story
paras: At the Dead Fields, Forsaken forces face a Scourge threat in northern Silverpine. High Executor Hadrec sends champions from the Sepulcher against the Rot Hide gnolls and the banshee who shields them.

North of the Sepulcher, an abandoned farmstead lies overrun by Rot Hide gnolls. The fields once held ordinary farms, but now these plague ridden scavengers infest the Silverpine countryside. High Executor Hadrec sent small raiding parties to drive them out. Each attack stalled under a strange magical resistance.

Nightlash, a Scourge banshee, directs the Rot Hide gnolls and scatters Forsaken skirmishers with dark sorcery when the gnolls face defeat. Hadrec sends Horde champions to cut down the gnolls and draw Nightlash into the open. He asks for her spectral essence as proof that she is destroyed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields. We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.
Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides. If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.
Her essence will turn to dust. Bring me that dust as proof.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you defeated Nightlash, friend? Our success against the rot hides depends on her destruction!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, friend, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.
The Scourge have lost ground this day. Your value to the Forsaken grows.
